headline: Football Manager 27 is out
title: Football Manager 27 Is Out | Launch Details | Gaming News
video_script: Football Manager twenty seven launched on November tenth, twenty twenty six, from Sega and Sports Interactive. It comes as a PC version, a console version for PlayStation five and Xbox, and a mobile version. The studio promised simpler club management, a more atmospheric match day and easier menu navigation. Will you take charge of your club this season? Comment below!
description: Football Manager 27 launched November 10, 2026 on PC, console and mobile. Sources: The Sixth Axis, Altchar.
joke: Every manager is a genius until the first home defeat.
